basics.name: Ilkka Toivola
basics.label: Hands-on Software Architect, Lead, Partner
basics.summary:
Ilkka has extensive skills and experience in designing and implementing robust, fault tolerant, highly available and scalable software solutions with a modern developer mindset built around AI-enhanced development.

Having worked across several industries and in the public sector, Ilkka has experience working with a variety of development team sizes, development cultures, multicultural/multicontinental teams, regulations, legacy requirements and security considerations.

With his experience as a scrum master and being involved in project management, Ilkka has a natural talent for problem solving and for removing blockers in development as well as translating business requirements into refined user stories for implementation.
basics.x-tagline: Writing code to fix a problem is the easy part; the real value lies in finding the right problem to tackle.

x-strengths.title: Continuous Improvement
x-strengths.description: A strong believer in the boy scout rule, Ilkka acknowledges that continuous improvement and leaving something better than you found it is a sustainable and low effort way of minimising technical debt and ensuring service health throughout the entire lifecycle of an application.

x-strengths.title: Quick learner
x-strengths.description: Ilkka is very adept at taking in lots of learning quickly and diving deep into the customer's domain to be able to solve an issue with the best applicable approach & technology.

x-keyRoles.title: Trust & Safety Developer
x-keyRoles.description: Working with player safety tools and moderation pipelines for a mobile game developer with a very large global player base.

x-keyRoles.title: Project architect & Team Lead
x-keyRoles.description: Architected & built the full backend infrastructure while leading a team to implement an electricity retailer's customer portal & mobile app (browser, iOS & Android), which went on to become one of the best rated end user mobile applications in the energy sector for several years.

x-keySkills.title: AI Project Experience
x-keySkills.description: Ilkka has supported multiple AI-initiatives by integrating LLMs & GenAI platforms into new and existing data processing pipelines.

x-keySkills.title: AI development tools
x-keySkills.description: In recent customer projects, Ilkka has been utilizing AI development tools such as GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT and Mistral to speed up the development process.

projects.name: Trust & Safety services for mobile games
projects.description: Working in a full Kipinä Development team, tasked with providing Trust & Safety related supporting services to the client's mobile games with a very large global player base. Services like content filtering, content moderation, fair play, player care among many others. Worked with game teams, third parties and other in-house teams to bring business critical and legally compliant player (especially young player) protections to games, including integrations with the National Investigation Authority. Technical work has included building out completely new systems from scratch, utilizing a full end-to-end stack all the way from infrastructure to the UI.
keywords: AWS Services (RDS, SNS, SES, SQS, S3, Lambda, ECS, Fargate, Kinesis, DynamoDB ECR etc.)

projects.name: Mobile app architecture evaluation
projects.description: Tasked with evaluating the architectural integrity and service health of their existing mobile app, specifically the backend, integrations and infrastructure as well as observability. Worked closely with the existing team & management to discover several points of improvement that were described in an architectural report. Some of the critical improvements were successfully implemented during the evaluation process, with good results.
keywords: Azure Services (API Management, Azure DevOps, Web apps, Azure Functions, CosmosDB)

projects.name: Mobile ticketing architecture review
projects.description: Tasked with creating a comprehensive architectural review of their existing mobile ticketing solution to evaluate technical health and pinpoint problematic areas, implementations and configurations. Resulting in an architectural report with proposals for implementation improvements, performance improvements and ways to ensure better fault tolerance.
keywords: AWS services (RDS, EKS, MSK, OpenSearch, Cognito, Cloudfront etc.)

projects.name: Customer service portal and application
projects.description: Returning as an architect to a project for an electricity sales company working on their multi-channel customer service portal/application. (See earlier experience). Mainly focused on working with 3rd parties/integrations (for example: SAF-integrations) for technical readiness for the national electricity data hub systems (first and second generation). Especially the 15-minute measurement resolution as well as support for community (“energiayhteisö”) based measurements. In addition to that, focused on increasing application performance due to higher user volume.
keywords: AWS services (DynamoDB, RDS, SNS, SES, SQS, S3, Lambda, Cognito, EC2 etc.)

projects.name: B2B e-SIM subscription management portal
projects.description: Working with e-sim technologies for an international telecommunications company, mainly on a B2B oriented customer portal for managing e-sim subscriptions. Ilkka was also tasked with updating Vaadin major version & ensuring compatibility during the version migration.

projects.name: IoT data intake platform
projects.description: Ilkka was a backend developer and oversaw the project as a scrum master. Working mainly with the backend of a large IoT data intake platform based on Apache Kafka.

projects.name: Multi-channel customer portal
projects.description:
The project for an electricity sales company covered a new customer portal development as a multi-channel solution (browser, iOS, Android). Ilkka was responsible for system architecture, backend, DevOps, and integrations. During the projects, he was working in close collaboration with the customer and stakeholders.

As project architect & team lead, he architected & built the full backend infrastructure while leading a team to implement the client's customer portal & mobile app (browser, iOS & Android), which went on to become one of the best rated end user mobile applications in the energy sector for several years. Responsibilities included backend, DevOps, integrations, observability & monitoring, team lead & project management in close collaboration with the customer & stakeholders. Notable integrations include the first and second generation national electricity data hub and several integrations to different local grid operators.
keywords: AWS services (RDS, SNS, SES, SQS, S3, Lambda, Cognito, EC2 etc.)

projects.name: Patient information system development
projects.description: Ilkka had varying roles in the development of two patient information systems. Responsibilities included printout reform, application development and the requirements management system administrator and trainer. Ilkka was also involved in the integration to the national health data archive & e-prescription functionality. From 2016 onwards, he was lead developer & scrum master of a team implementing a new pharmacotherapy monitoring application that would be integrated into the existing patient care systems.
